payload.title: File:Langstonia xenastrapotherium.png
payload.description_html: Reconstruction of the hypothetical scavenging event consistent with the ichnofossils visible on UCMP 38115, with Langstonia huilensis (Reptilia, Crocodyliformes, Sebecidae) consuming the carcass of a Xenastrapotherium kraglievichi (Mammalia, Astrapotheria, Astrapotheriidae). Also pictured in the background is Huilatherium pluriplicatum (Mammalia, Notoungulata, Leontiniidae), known from the UCMP V4528 locality Source: https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/02724634.2026.2701154#d1e2171
